source: ImageToolbox lib/collages (frames/*FrameImage.kt via CollageLayoutFactory.COLLAGE_MAP / loadFrameImages); DSL layouts evaluated at their initial parameter values. Order = upstream picker order (asset names in byte order, stable-sorted by frame count).
units: bound: fraction of canvas [l, t, r, b]; points/clear_area_points: fraction of the frame bound; path/clear_path points+bounds: raw upstream path units (placed at render time like FrameImageView.buildRealPath / buildRealClearPath); shrink_map: multiples of the spacing
